topic_prompt_overlay: NICHE LOCK (Ghost Ships): only propose topics that fit this niche's video type. Video type: Abandoned vessels found adrift — like the Mary Celeste — with no crew, no struggle, only silence. Theories range from mutiny to supernatural. Follow niche topic strategy: Monitor maritime news, ocean expedition updates, or viral YouTube mysteries. Generate a topic that combines fact and legend.
video_prompt_overlay: NICHE VISUAL LOCK (Ghost Ships / mystery): Generate a 7–9 second dialogue clip based on the topic `{topic}`. Each dialogue must be haunting and speculative. For each dialogue, generate: - **Audio Generation Prompt:** Voice — eerie, with creaking wood and foghorn. - **Video Generation Prompt:** Detailed visual — empty ship deck, foggy ocean. No characters — focus on swinging lantern or rope. Lighting: grey, fog-diffused. Maintain same fog density and grey tones. Forbidden: talking-head lip-sync avatar, burned-in captions, watermark, modern meme text, modern smartphones, cars, LED screens, sneakers. Preferred subjects: Ghost Ships documentary subject, period-accurate environment, evidence object close-up. Lighting: dappled fog light, cool teal shadows, slow push-ins. Face policy: no talking-head lip-sync avatar; cinematic B-roll preferred. Dialogue tone: slow, ominous, evidence-first. Ambience: low drone, subtle reverb, sparse percussion.
